# Crush Formatter

<!-- Auto-generated by `pnpm docs:formatters`. Do not edit manually. -->

PromptScript compiles your `.prs` sources to native Crush configuration. The main output is `AGENTS.md`. It is not enabled by default, add it to `targets` to use it.

## Enable the Target

```yaml
targets:
  - crush
```

Pick an output version when you need more than the default:

```yaml
targets:
  - crush:
      version: full
```

## At a Glance

| Property          | Value                                 |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| **Tier**          | Tier 3                                |
| **Main output**   | `AGENTS.md`                           |
| **Dot directory** | `.crush/`                             |
| **Skills**        | Yes (`.crush/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`) |
| **Agents**        | No                                    |
| **Commands**      | No                                    |
| **Local files**   | No                                    |

## Output Files

| File              | Path                            | Purpose                    |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| Main instructions | `AGENTS.md`                     | Primary rule file          |
| Skills            | `.crush/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | Reusable skill definitions |

## Output Versions

| Version          | Output                                                      |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `simple`         | Single AGENTS.md file                                       |
| `multifile`      | AGENTS.md + .crush/mcp.json (skills via full mode)          |
| `full` (default) | Multifile + .crush/skills/<name>/SKILL.md + .crush/mcp.json |

## MCP and Hooks

| Block         | Support                  |
| ------------- | ------------------------ |
| `@mcpServers` | `.crush/mcp.json` (json) |
| `@hooks`      | Not supported            |

Native hook reference: <https://promptscript.dev/docs/guides/hooks/>
